GOAL: orient in the workspace before proposing.
READ: nothing yet; listing working dir.
OBSERVED: starting ideation round 2, single idea, needs append_progress records.
REASONING: first map existing baseline files so the proposal is not a copy.
OPEN: inspect baseline TIGER_CURV-RESID-CONTRAST and Stage2/Stage3 code.

ANSWER (full text printed in the reply; record too long for the 4000-char cap).
IDEA: GEO-RAY-CONTRAST-RQ.
MECHANISM IN ONE LINE: three-level hyperbolic prefix tree whose level-l codewords are exp_{c_parent}(eta_l * u_{l,k}) at a FIXED per-node radius eta_l = median log-map residual norm, with directions u built from popularity-adjusted directed-transition CONTRAST, assigned by a balanced Lorentzian Sinkhorn on cost (1+b_i)*d_Lorentz(x_i, c_{l,k}), residual = log map at the assigned child; Stage 2 trains only U_l (3x256x32).
COUPLING EQUATION: C_ik = (1 + b_i(S_p)) * d_Lorentz(x_i, exp_{c_p}(eta_l u_{l,k})), then Sinkhorn(-C/eps), eps = median(C)/2.
WHY IT DIFFERS: fixed-radius rays make zero-residual collapse structurally impossible (round-one lesson 2); frozen Stage-1 text geometry retained; behaviour acts on DIRECTION and assignment WEIGHT, never on radius (so not BRad-RQ), no cone constraint (not behcone), no Frechet barycentre update (not poincare-frechet), curvature fixed at c=1 and not used as a per-level knob (not CURVCTRL), no Gromov-delta and no tree-ness premise (issue 126a).
SWITCHES: b=0 (behaviour off, unweighted directions + unweighted Sinkhorn); Euclidean (additive codeword, L2 distance, subtractive residual = c->0 limit, behaviour kept); both on (only arm trained).
COST: 450-750 s for 3000 epochs vs 571 s measured; 24 steps/epoch, ~6-10 ms/step, 24,576 trainable scalars.
EXPECTED OBSERVABLES: L2/L3 distinct prefixes above 1769/2201, items per deepest prefix below ~14, prefix-transition accuracy, Stage-3 test_recall@10 vs 0.065.
EVIDENCE: prompt round-one block only (repo/parent-round dirs denied by external-directory permission).
OPEN: none; no ablation, sweep or seed repetition required.
